sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य गुरोः पादौ कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्।निकुम्भिलामभिययौ चैत्यं रावणिपालितम् ।। ६.८५.२९ ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya guroḥ pādau kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam।nikumbhilāmabhiyayau caityaṁ rāvaṇipālitam ।। 6.85.29 ।।

translations.english: Saluting the feet of the eldest brother and going round him, Laksmana proceeded to Nikumbhila sanctuary ruled by Ravana.
